Neighborhood: Asakusa, 2 min from Asakusa Station (basement) - 3 stops from Ueno on the Ginza Line
Description: Backup dinner for Day 11. Gyukatsu - breaded beef cutlet fried rare that you finish on a hot stone at your seat. Tabelog 3.46 (377 reviews). About 20 counter seats and known for long lines; one reviewer says you can now join the queue through the Catch a Table app. Quick and inexpensive. Takes cards.
Best Time To Visit: If Tori no Ichi cannot seat you: Ginza Line from Ueno to Asakusa (about 5 min). Last order 9:00pm, so leave Ueno by ~8:30pm
Tags: dinner; gyukatsu; beef cutlet; casual; walk-in

Name: Tori Mitsukuni Ueno (鳥光國 上野店)
Neighborhood: Ueno no Mori Sakura Terrace B1F, 1 min from JR Ueno Station
Description: Second backup dinner for Day 11. Yakitori restaurant with 90 seats and a wider menu: a 13-vegetable salad, fish carpaccio, liver pate and chicken hot pots. Tabelog 3.40 (513 reviews). Listed as non-smoking on Tabelog. The menu is on a tablet in Japanese only, so have a translation app ready.
Best Time To Visit: If Tori no Ichi is full and you would rather stay by the station than go to Asakusa
Reservation Info: Not booked - online or phone 050-5890-6408; walk-ins may have to wait at busy times

Name: Unagi Yondaime Kikukawa (うなぎ四代目菊川) - Midland Square
Neighborhood: Midland Square 4F, 2 min walk from Nagoya Station
Hours: Sat 11:00-22:00 (L.O. 21:00); irregular closures, follows Midland Square (Tabelog, checked 16 Oct 2026)
Description: DAY 17 LUNCH. Hitsumabushi - grilled eel over rice, eaten in three stages: plain, with condiments, then with dashi poured over - 2 minutes from Nagoya Station. 68 seats. Tabelog 3.58 (694 reviews). Being at the station keeps the day simple: lunch straight off the 12:04 Hida, then the Toyota museum is 2 minutes away on the Meitetsu line.
Best Time To Visit: ~12:20pm, straight off the 12:04 Hida - put the bags in a station locker first
Tags: hitsumabushi; unagi; Nagoya specialty; near station; Tabelog verified 3.58
Must See Highlight: Order the regular hitsumabushi and finish the last third with the dashi
Reservation Info: Not booked yet - book online via Tabelog or phone 050-5890-3699 for ~12:20 on Sat 17 Oct

Name: Sumiyaki Una Fuji Meieki (炭焼うな富士 名駅店)
Neighborhood: Nagoya Mitsui Building North B1F, 3-4 min walk from Nagoya Station
Description: Backup lunch. Charcoal-grilled eel and hitsumabushi from the Una Fuji group, whose main shop is a Tabelog 100 pick. Tabelog 3.62 (1,660 reviews), 57 seats. Walk-in queues here are long, but it takes bookings - so if Kikukawa is full, book this one rather than turning up.
Best Time To Visit: ~12:20pm, only if Kikukawa cannot seat you
Tags: hitsumabushi; unagi; near station; Tabelog verified 3.62; bookable
Reservation Info: Not booked - bookable online via Tabelog. Only book it if Kikukawa is full; walk-in queues are long

Name: G.Itoya (銀座 伊東屋 本店)
Description: Ginza's stationery flagship: eight shopping floors organised by use - pens and fountain pens, paper, notebooks, diaries and desk goods - so it is a one-stop shop across many stationery brands. The K.Itoya annex behind it has Japanese paper and calligraphy goods. Last of the four Ginza shops - take the bags back to your stay near Tokyo Station before Shibuya.
Best Time To Visit: ~2:10pm, a few minutes' walk from UNIQLO TOKYO. Finish by ~2:35pm, then drop the bags at your stay before Shibuya
Tags: stationery; multi-brand; fountain pens; paper; Ginza

Name: Yakiniku Horumon Nikugoro Yokocho (焼肉ホルモン肉五郎 横丁店)
Hours: 11:00-23:00 daily, last order 22:00, no regular closed day (Hot Pepper, checked 19 Oct 2026)
Description: Self-grill yakiniku and horumon on Tenjinbashisuji, about 5 min from JR Tenma north exit - on the walk north toward Osaka Naniwaya. Lunch set meals (yukhoe teishoku and others). Tabelog 3.46. 44 seats, 16 at the counter, fully non-smoking. Open straight through from 11:00, so no lunch last order to beat.
Best Time To Visit: ~1:30-2:20pm, about 15 min walk north from Minami-morimachi through the arcade
Tags: yakiniku; self-grill; wagyu; horumon; walk-in; non-smoking
Reservation Info: Walk-in. Online booking also open until 21:00 same day (Hot Pepper). Reviews: a Sunday walk-in at opening was seated, a Sunday after 12:30 was turned away - a weekday ~1:30 should be easier.

Name: Yakiniku Maru Minamimorimachi (焼肉マル 南森町店)
Hours: Lunch 12:00-17:00; dinner 17:00-23:00 Mon-Thu/Sun; irregular closures (Gurunavi, checked 19 Oct 2026)
Description: Casual self-grill yakiniku chain, 3 min from Minami-morimachi Station - at the south end of the Tenjinbashisuji walk, where you come up from the subway. Weekday value lunch set with free rice refills. Tabelog 3.41. 50 seats including counter.
Best Time To Visit: Backup: ~1:15pm straight off the subway if hungry, or walk back ~15 min if Nikugoro is full
Reservation Info: Walk-in (no policy stated; 50 seats). Irregular closures not checkable in advance.
